content: Socorro Antenna collector accepts HTTP POST multipart/form-data (or mixed) with Content-Length to /submit; the crashing-process minidump part must be named upload_file_minidump; annotations as parts or single JSON extra part; accepted returns HTTP 200 body CrashID=<uuid>, rejected returns 200 Discarded=<rule>, malformed returns 400 Discarded=<reason>; throttler rules live in antenna/throttler.py; collector only assigns ID + timestamps and queues to S3/SQS, no stackwalking.
